rationale: The assistant correctly recognised a cooker hood as outside its nine covered families and declined without inventing anything or recommending parts, pointing to the manufacturer's support line and guarantee and advising 'keep it unplugged rather than opening it up', which covers isolation. It only implicitly answered the customer's direct question of whether the hood is part of the hob, and did not explicitly warn that a humming non-spinning motor should not be left running, nor name Bosch service or an appliance engineer, nor offer the easy filter-cleaning tip. A sound but slightly generic decline.
